binary-shift.editorialSetting: Study positive integers x whose fixed-width binary digits rotate when multiplied by the width n. Both x and nx must fit in n bits. Relate the rotation to divisibility, then count distinct values under numerical bounds.

parity-engine.editorialSetting: Track the parity of a recurrence. From s, form t=s+a. The next value is t+1 for even t and t+b for odd t. Compare independent fair binary inputs with parity inputs from fair seven-sided dice, starting at s=0.

number-forge.editorialSetting: For generators 9,15,25 and then 9,21,49, investigate nonnegative integer linear combinations. Count positive gaps by parity and use residues modulo 3 to reduce the reachability calculation.

grid-dominion.editorialSetting: Two players alternately color unused vertices of a rectangular grid graph. Either player may choose either color. Count monochromatic neighbor edges by color. Unequal final totals favor Player 1; equal totals favor Player 2. Study symmetry strategies and achievable imbalance.

language-labyrinth.editorialSetting: Start with the words a and b. Permitted transformations are u -> cu; a split u=wv with nonempty w gives vwv; and a leading a may be removed while appending b. Investigate palindromes, including words of length 10 that contain both a and b. Historical conclusions below are not silently corrected.

temporal-graphs.editorialSetting: Add distinct unit edges between allowed plane points in time order. An edge owner qualifies once its endpoints are joined by a simple path made only of later edges. Investigate how many owners qualify for the first time on one day, and distinguish that from the accumulated set of owners who have qualified.

loop-strings.editorialSetting: Model n labeled connections by a permutation. A move cyclically permutes three distinct right endpoints. Closing equally labeled ends turns permutation cycles into loops. Study the minimum cycle length and count loop partitions, with the seven-label case as a concrete instance.
